speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye
text: asked the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources with the implementation of the smoking ban in the Orchard Road area on 1 January 2019 (a) what is the trend in the number of offenders since the implementation; (b) whether there are plans to add more designated smoking areas; and (c) whether the Ministry will consider moving these designated smoking areas away from main pedestrian thoroughfare.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: An advisory approach was adopted in the first three months of the implementation, to give the public sufficient time to adjust to the smoking prohibition.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: With greater public awareness, this number fell sharply when enforcement started on 1 April 2019.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: The NSZ covers a relatively large area with numerous commercial premises.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Given the high footfall and densely built-up nature of Orchard Road, careful consideration is made on the location of DSAs.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: This will help protect public health and avoid normalising smoking.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: NEA will continue to monitor the ground situation and review the location of DSAs if necessary.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Everyone plays a part in keeping the environment clean and liveable.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Families and friends of smokers, as well as the general public, can help reinforce the right social norms through timely and friendly reminders for smokers to use the DSAs.

speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
text: Since the smoking ban took effect, I have received much feedback from residents living near Orchard Road that smoking activity has been displaced to the fringes of their residential estates.

speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
text: This has caused disamenities to residents living there.

speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
text: Basically, smokers have moved to smoking just outside of the No-Smoking Zone and outside residents' homes such as along Nutmeg Road and along the fringes of Jalan Lada Puteh.

speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
text: Some smokers have even shifted a dustbin and created their own smoking corner along Nutmeg Road.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: We have also engaged the service provider in that area to step up the cleaning frequency to ensure the cleanliness of the area.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: I think what we want to do is to urge the smokers to be socially responsible and considerate, not to congregate around the fringes of the estate to smoke, but actually to move to the nearest DSAs within the Orchard Road No Smoking Zone instead.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: We will continue to monitor the ground situation and review the locations of the DSAs if necessary.
